cameras.autoTrackingNote: AI Auto Framing tracks the subject in real time to keep the shot framed, with hand gestures to lock tracking or switch view angles.

fieldNotes.streamingProtocols: Also streams over SSP, Z CAM's own streaming protocol. NDI|HX3 is available as a separately purchased upgrade license; the P2-R1N has it built in.

cameras.description: Z CAM's PTZ camera brings the color science of its cinema cameras to a pan-tilt-zoom head; this is the standard-reach 18x version on a 1/1.3-inch sensor. A bright f/1.6 lens, phase-detection autofocus and AI auto framing with gesture control, 4K60 over HDMI and IP alongside 3G-SDI, plus genlock, FreeD tracking output, tally lights and a fanless body, aimed at live production, streaming and virtual studio work.
